spans.s: cl. 2. Ā. (Dhātup. xxiv, 17) शिङ्क्ते (accord. to Vop. also cl. 1. 10. Ā. शिञ्जते, शिञ्जयते; pr. p. शिञ्जान, or शिञ्जत् [see below] Kāv.; pf. शिशिञ्जे Gr.; aor. अशिञ्जिष्ट, ib.; fut. शिञ्जिता, शिञ्जिष्यते, ib.), to utter a shrill sound, tinkle, rattle, jingle, whirr, buzz, hum, twang, bellow, roar, RV.; &c. [Cf. collateral √ सिञ्ज्.]

(also written सिञ्जा) tinkle, jingle, (esp.) the tinkling sound of silver ornaments on the ankles or wrist, Hcar. (accord. to some also, m(शिञ्ज). )
